differential.name: Iron deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Microcytic RBCs (MCV 39 fL) with low MPV and anemia flag suggest iron loss, common in middle‑aged adults and consistent with chronic inflammation or occult GI bleeding.

differential.name: Beta thalassemia trait
differential.rationale: Marked microcytosis with relatively normal/high hemoglobin and elevated RBC count points to a hemoglobinopathy often seen in individuals of African descent.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease
differential.rationale: Co‑existing chronic sinusitis, acute bronchitis, obesity‑related inflammation can cause mild microcytic anemia with normal iron stores.

differential.name: Sideroblastic anemia
differential.rationale: Microcytosis with normal/high hemoglobin and low MPV may reflect a disorder of heme synthesis, especially in the setting of metabolic syndrome.

differential.name: Lead poisoning
differential.rationale: Rare but can cause microcytic anemia with low MPV; consider occupational exposure given limited social context.
